## Same shape, different vertical scale {#l2-change-the-scale }

```{=html}
<div data-module="chart" data-set="sheets" data-modes="frequency,relative"></div>
```



::: {.takeaway}
Every height is divided by the same total, $n=32$.
:::

::: notes
Switch frequency to relative frequency and keep the polygon selected. Proportions are .125,.25,.375,.1875,.0625. Explain why positive uniform vertical rescaling preserves the shape. The graph axes rescale as well.
:::
